components.name: Primary button
components.description: Compact indigo action with keyboard focus.
components.css: .primary-button { font: 500 11px 'DM Sans Variable', sans-serif; background: #5147ce; color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; min-height: 36px; padding: 10px 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .18s; } .primary-button:hover { background: #4137b4; } .primary-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9f99ee; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .primary-button { transition: none; } }

components.name: Opportunity impact breakdown
components.description: Existing light panel with indigo score, deadline/effort metadata and native disclosure containing labeled meters, numeric values, profile evidence and estimate caveat.

components.name: Action stepper
components.description: Numbered circles and thin connectors; check/lock icons accompany textual ready, resume-required, conditional, locked, skipped and completed states. Mark done/Undo and shortlist controls support preparation tracking.

components.name: Focus budget
components.description: Pressed-state 15/30/60-minute presets and custom draft input; blur or Enter commits a rounded 5–180-minute budget to the heading and ordered action plan.

components.name: Resume file controls
components.description: File picker/drop zone with saving and replacement states, wrapping filename and metadata, labeled download/remove buttons, error alert and browser-only privacy disclosure.

components.name: Analyzer review
components.description: Source and editable facts/actions in two columns, stacked below 1000px; confidence and source-review confirmation precede adding a notice. Includes impact preview and reduced-motion-aware processing feedback.

components.name: College mail split pane
components.description: Bordered inbox and reader with search, unread and starred states, a pale-indigo AI action, clear empty states and a mobile list-to-reader transition below 800px.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-mail-shell { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(270px,34%) 1fr; min-height:360px; overflow:hidden; background:#fff; border:1px solid #e7e9ef; border-radius:10px; color:#252735; font-family:'DM Sans Variable',sans-serif; } .ds-mail-list { background:#fafafe; border-right:1px solid #e7e9ef; } .ds-mail-list>strong { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:20px; font-family:'Manrope Variable',sans-serif; } .ds-mail-list>strong span { display:grid; place-items:center; min-width:24px; height:24px; border-radius:999px; background:#5147ce; color:#fff; font-size:11px; } .ds-mail-list label { margin:0 16px 10px; height:39px; padding:0 11px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; border:1px solid #e7e9ef; border-radius:8px; background:#fff; color:#697080; } .ds-mail-list svg { width:16px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; } .ds-mail-list input { min-width:0; border:0; outline:0; font:inherit; } .ds-mail-row { width:100%; padding:16px 18px; display:grid; gap:5px; text-align:left; border:0; border-top:1px solid #e7e9ef; background:#ebe9fb; color:#252735; cursor:pointer; } .ds-mail-row span { font-size:12px; font-weight:700; } .ds-mail-row small { color:#697080; } .ds-mail-row:hover { background:#f1f0fb; } .ds-mail-row:focus-visible,.ds-mail-reader button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #9f99ee; outline-offset:-3px; } .ds-mail-reader { padding:30px clamp(24px,5vw,64px); } .ds-mail-reader>small { color:#5549a5; font-size:9px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.04em; } .ds-mail-reader h3 { max-width:660px; margin:14px 0 20px; font:700 24px/1.3 'Manrope Variable',sans-serif; } .ds-mail-reader p { max-width:72ch; color:#3d4150; line-height:1.8; } .ds-mail-reader button { margin-top:20px; min-height:36px; padding:10px 14px; border:0; border-radius:7px; background:#5147ce; color:#fff; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; } .ds-mail-reader button:hover { background:#4137b4; } @media(max-width:800px){.ds-mail-shell{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ds-mail-list{border-right:0}.ds-mail-reader{display:none}}

components.name: Calendar agenda handoff
components.description: Chronological agenda row with separate opportunity and prefilled Google Calendar destinations; the calendar action becomes a full-width 44px row on narrow screens.
components.html: Add to Google Calendar
components.css: .ds-agenda-row { display:flex; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid #e7e9ef; border-radius:10px; background:#fff; font-family:'DM Sans Variable',sans-serif; } .ds-agenda-row>button { flex:1; min-width:0; padding:16px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:100px 1fr auto; gap:14px; align-items:center; text-align:left; border:0; background:#fff; color:#252735; cursor:pointer; } .ds-agenda-row>a { min-height:44px; padding:0 16px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; border-left:1px solid #e7e9ef; color:#5147ce; font-size:11px; font-weight:800; text-decoration:none; } .ds-agenda-row svg { width:16px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; } .ds-agenda-row>button:hover,.ds-agenda-row>a:hover { background:#f0eefb; } .ds-agenda-row>button:focus-visible,.ds-agenda-row>a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #9f99ee; outline-offset:-3px; } @media(max-width:800px){.ds-agenda-row{flex-direction:column}.ds-agenda-row>button{width:100%;grid-template-columns:70px 1fr auto}.ds-agenda-row>a{justify-content:center;border-left:0;border-top:1px solid #e7e9ef}}

narrative.overview: Operate mode: light surfaces, restrained indigo and compact information. Deadlines lead; profile-based eligibility makes opportunities explainable.

rules.name: Readable secondary ink
rules.body: Use final stylesheet overrides for metadata, assistant copy and urgent deadlines.

rules.name: Transient elevation
rules.body: Reserve shadows for toasts, notifications and command palette.

dos: Do explain eligibility with profile evidence.
Do preserve focus and reduced motion.
Do preserve list-reader hierarchy and a visible mobile route back to the inbox.
Do keep calendar handoffs adjacent to the deadline or opportunity they describe.
donts: Don't communicate status through color alone.
Don't emphasize every surface with indigo.
Don't imply demo retrieval is live integration.
Don't present the synthetic inbox as a connected campus email account.
